 Third round of October Social Security payments goes out in three days
 By Adisa Hargett-Robinson 
 Published
 October 25, 2026 6:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The third round of October Social Security payments for retirees, now capped at $5,181, will be issued in three days.
 When will payments arrive?
 Retirees born on or after the 21st of a month will receive this payment on Wednesday, Oct. 28 .
